description: Summary figure: ftm3 vs two long PF09437 members, dG-predictor TM calls, hydropathy, AlphaFold pLDDT
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,
    'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
def kdwin(s,w=19):
    h=np.array([KD[c] for c in s]); o=np.full(len(s),np.nan)
    for i in range(len(s)-w+1): o[i+w//2]=h[i:i+w].mean()
    return o

accs=[("P0CU06","ftm3  SPAC750.04c"),("Q9P3E6","SPAC750.05c"),("P0CU16","SPAC977.01")]
S={};PLD={}
for a,_ in accs:
    S[a]=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.json",timeout=60).json()["sequence"]["value"]
    pdb=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-{a}-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=60).text
    PLD[a]=np.array([float(l[60:66]) for l in pdb.splitlines() if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"])
DGP={"P0CU06":[(38,59,-0.63)],
     "Q9P3E6":[(95,117,-0.41),(124,145,1.05),(178,196,-0.39),(198,220,-0.65),(266,288,-0.30)],
     "P0CU16":[(67,89,-0.41),(96,117,1.05),(150,168,-0.39),(170,192,-0.65),(238,260,-0.30)]}

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13.5,8.2))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,3,height_ratios=[1.15,0.85,0.9],hspace=0.55,wspace=0.22)
for col,(a,lab) in enumerate(accs):
    n=len(S[a]); x=np.arange(1,n+1); kd=kdwin(S[a])
    ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,col])
    ax.plot(x,kd,color="#1f4e79",lw=1.5)
    ax.axhline(1.6,color="#c0392b",ls="--",lw=1)
    ax.axhline(0,color="grey",lw=0.5)
    for (p,q,g) in DGP[a]:
        ax.axvspan(p,q,color="#f0a202",alpha=0.35)
    ax.set_xlim(1,360); ax.set_ylim(-3.4,2.7)
    ax.set_title(f"{lab}  ({n} aa)\ndG-predictor: {len(DGP[a])} TM helix" + ("" if len(DGP[a])==1 else "es"),fontsize=10)
    ax.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle w=19" if col==0 else "")
    if col==0: ax.text(100,2.0,"threshold 1.6",color="#c0392b",fontsize=8)

    ax2=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,col])
    ax2.plot(np.arange(1,len(PLD[a])+1),PLD[a],color="#2e7d32",lw=1.3)
    ax2.axhline(70,color="grey",ls=":",lw=1)
    for (p,q,g) in DGP[a]: ax2.axvspan(p,q,color="#f0a202",alpha=0.35)
    ax2.set_xlim(1,360); ax2.set_ylim(0,100)
    ax2.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT" if col==0 else ""); ax2.set_xlabel("residue")
    ax2.text(0.03,0.82,"mean %.1f, 0%% above 70"%PLD[a].mean() if (PLD[a]>70).mean()<0.02 else "mean %.1f"%PLD[a].mean(),
             transform=ax2.transAxes,fontsize=8)

    ax3=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,col])
    ax3.add_patch(Rectangle((1,0.35),n,0.30,facecolor="#dfe6ed",edgecolor="#8a97a3"))
    for (p,q,g) in DGP[a]:
        c="#e07b39" if g<0 else "#c9b037"
        ax3.add_patch(Rectangle((p,0.25),q-p+1,0.50,facecolor=c,edgecolor="k",lw=0.6))
        ax3.text((p+q)/2,0.82,f"{g:+.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=7.5)
    ax3.set_xlim(1,360); ax3.set_ylim(0,1.15); ax3.set_yticks([])
    ax3.set_xlabel("residue")
    ax3.set_title("predicted TM segments, dG (kcal/mol)",fontsize=8.5)
fig.suptitle("ftm3 (P0CU06) has one transmembrane helix, not five: the '5TM' of Pfam PF09437 belongs to the 316-344 aa members\n"
             "dG predictor (Hessa biological hydrophobicity scale), Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy, and AlphaFold confidence, same pipeline for all three proteins",
             fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0,0,1,0.93])
plt.show()
